messages:
Maria G: quick sync request — can we block 30–45m next week for a cross-func roadmap decision? we need PM + infra + runtime to settle priorities for autoscale v2 vs cache/quant improvements.
Samir: +1. I think agenda should include RFC review, expected customer impact, and decision owner.
Alex R: available Mon/Tue mornings. can we get the RFC linked in thread?
Maria G: here — RFC: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/autoscale-v2. also draft agenda below:
```
1) RFC highlights (5m)
2) Trade-offs: autoscale vs cache/quant (15m)
3) Decision log & owner assignment (10m)
4) Action items & follow-ups (5m)
```
JH: Tue 10:30 PT works for me. Also pinging @Noah for infra capacity context.
Noah: Tue 10:30 PT okay. note: infra can only commit to limited dedicate pools in Q2, might affect rollout window.
Samir: can someone add a short PR with perf numbers for cache vs quant? 1 slide would do.
Alex R: I can put together a perf mini-slide. planning to run the benchmark today, will post results here by EOD.
Lina-bot: Reminder: create calendar event? Use /cal create "Roadmap Decision: Autoscale v2" Tue 10:30 PT 45m #product @samir @maria_g @alex_r @jh @noah
Maria G: thanks — agenda owner: Samir for decision framing, Alex for perf data, Noah for infra constraints.
Samir: adding quick note — if we choose cache-first, we need to update the Optimize roadmap and notify customers on potential latency uplift.
Alex R: perf numbers posted: summary: cache-only: -18% token cost, latency +8%; quant-first: -34% token cost, latency +18% on long-context. details in doc: https://redwood-internal/notes/cache-vs-quant-bench.md
JH: thanks. that helps. my vote leans cache-first for now (less latency risk).
Noah: infra note: cache-first reduces peak throughput requirements, easier to provision on Dedicated. :thumbsup:
Samir: +1 cache-first unless a clear customer signal prefers max-cost reduction.
Maria G: decision provisional: cache-first, owner: Alex R to draft rollout plan + decision record in Decision Log (Notion) by Fri EOD.
Alex R: got it, will draft and link here.
Maria G: thanks everyone. calendar invite sent. :wave:
